description: Search a bank of complete, measurable example IEP goals by skill, such as requesting a break, AAC, reading fluency, or transition planning. Each goal has a condition, observable skill, criterion, measurement method, and timeframe. Use when drafting or reviewing IEP goals.

area.description: Limit results to one skill area.

autism_specific.description: Set true to return only goals tagged for autistic students.

limit.description: Maximum goals to return. Defaults to 10.

query.description: Skill or topic to search for. Omit to browse by area.

name: search_iep_goals
title: Search IEP goals
